question.text: The SEBI Act was enacted in:

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI Act, 1992 provides for the establishment of SEBI with statutory powers to protect investor interests, promote the development of the securities market, and regulate the securities market. The Trap: 1956 is the year of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act (SCRA) and 1999 is the year of FEMA; these are distinct statutes in the regulatory framework. Note: The SEBI Act, 1992 appears in the regulatory framework as the statute that grants SEBI its mandate over the securities market.
